map.输入客户终身价值 LTV 与获客成本 CAC，计算两者健康比率，评估用户价值与营: Enter customer lifetime value LTV and acquisition cost CAC to compute the health ratio between them, assessing the balance between user value and marketing investment.
map.看获客投入与用户终身价值的回报比。: Look at the return ratio between acquisition spend and customer lifetime value.
map.比值≥3 健康、2–3 良好、1–2 偏低、<1 危险。: A ratio of 3 or more is healthy, 2-3 good, 1-2 low, below 1 dangerous.
map.由比值算 ROI 与可加大投放的空间。: Compute ROI and the room to increase spend from the ratio.
map.：LTV=3000、CAC=500 → 比值=3000/500=6:1，利润=2: : LTV = 3000, CAC = 500 -> ratio = 3000/500 = 6:1, profit = 2500, ROI = 2500/500 x 100 = 500%, far above the healthy 3:1 line, so budget can increase.
map.：LTV=800、CAC=1000 → 比值 0.8:1 <1，每获客亏 200: : LTV = 800, CAC = 1000 -> ratio 0.8:1, below 1, losing 200 per customer acquired; you must cut CAC or raise LTV before spending more.
map.经验值：留 1 份覆盖 CAC、1 份覆盖服务与变动成本、1 份作利润，低于 3: Rule of thumb: keep 1 part to cover CAC, 1 part for service and variable costs and 1 part as profit; below 3 it is hard to cover hidden costs.
map.比值高但要不要无限加投？: Should you keep increasing spend when the ratio is high?
map.不是。边际 CAC 随规模上升，比值会衰减，应在比值跌破 3 前停止加量。: No. Marginal CAC rises with scale and the ratio decays, so stop increasing volume before the ratio falls below 3.
